Hi all,

I've previously gotten this working, but now seem to have broken it somehow and can't get it back.

I'm trying to draw an epidemic curve using R (as per this post on SO: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/12161154/formatting-histogram-x-axis-when-working-with-dates-using-r )   Getting the curve working is fine, but it breaks when I try to reformat the axes.

> library(ggplot2)
> library(scales)
> library(date)
> head(debug)
 
 outbreak      onset     notify
1        A 2012-11-30 2012-12-06
2        A 2012-12-02 2012-12-07

> attach(debug)
> q <- ggplot(debug, aes(onset)) + geom_histogram()
> q

-> this plots a graph

> q + scale_x_date()

Error in q + scale_x_date() : non-numeric argument to binary operator
In addition: Warning message:
Incompatible methods ("+.gg", "Ops.date") for "+" 

What am I doing here that is making the scale_x_date not like my dates?

Thanks in advance,

Trent.
